purpose: Reviewer follow-up with fixed analyses; no new architecture or hyperparameter search
selection: 2020-2021; original complete-input validation early stopping, unchanged training recipe

missing_weather.mask: torch CPU generator 777, one common persisted mask per scenario for all models; differs from historical GPU-stream mask and will be evaluated anew for both
missing_weather.features: Apply mask to raw weather channels4:8 in each 168h history. Native LightGBM NaNs in missing lags/differences; available-only mean/std, NaN if no observations. Additional causal train-mean imputation control. Both reported, no test selection.
missing_weather.adapter: Frozen empirical and Chronos base adapters and empirical no-availability, seed17, original checkpoint; trained with their historical mask recipe.
missing_weather.strong_baseline: Keep original frozen161-feature36-model LightGBM, no weakening or retuning. Report both NaN and train-mean policies.

high_wave: For common diagnostic compare all models using site-specific95th percentile of all training hourly SWH. Report medianMAE,q90pinball,coverage80,intervalscore80. No test threshold fitting.
paper_policy: Query and availability usefulness are empirical hypotheses, not guaranteed sources of accuracy; separate base adapter diagnostics from complete-input fusion results.
